jobs.name: city_05
jobs.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production square Three Kingdoms Chinese strategy-game city battlefield background. One distinct original city composition, not a color swap. Polished AA-oriented semi-realistic hand-painted 2.5D environment, crisp readable material edges and refined brushwork, authentic Han-era details. Orthographic very steep overhead camera, no sky or horizon, one continuous flat ground plane. The central 80 percent is EMPTY freely traversable paving or earth, with continuous empty routes reaching all four edges. Scenery is sparse and restricted to the outermost 10 percent/corners, never blocking movement or creating corridors. Gentle warm sunlight, restrained contact shadows near the perimeter only. Natural harmonious colors that fit a warm ivory rice-paper and antique-gold Chinese game UI. Ground material has fine small-scale details but low overall contrast so cards read clearly. Absolutely no people, units, cards, UI, text, signs, watermarks, bridge, river, pond, stairs, central building, central props, road-blocking walls or big diamond/checkerboard paving. Square image. Theme: 宛城 Wancheng: warm grey small irregular rectangular stone paving, discreet pine branches and a few rustic ceramic jars only at far outside corners; small Han wooden shop eaves cropped at perimeter; large clean open courtyard.

jobs.name: ground_04
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production square seamless ground texture for a refined Three Kingdoms strategy game. Strict direct 90-degree overhead view of ONLY the ground material itself, uniform soft ambient illumination, NO perspective, vignette, directional or cast shadows. Polished AA-oriented semi-realistic hand-painted texture with crisp material edges, nuanced natural microdetail, clean readable small-scale pattern and low overall contrast. Warm ivory parchment-compatible palette. Full bleed texture with stone seams and material patterns continuing across all edges; make opposing edges as seamless/tileable as possible. No border, people, buildings, props, grass, leaves, plants, water, interface, text or watermark. Avoid huge slabs, giant diamond shapes, large checkerboards and overly sharp dark cracks. This is an original pattern, not a recolor of another city texture. Square image. Material: 宜城 Yicheng: fine small blue-grey weathered stone rectangles in a subtle irregular staggered pattern, restrained pale mineral grain, gently worn edges, very narrow soft mortar joints. No foliage or willow shadows.
